note: What stage_release.py checks before staging a release (PLT-12, D-26). Each managed target's expected type, link destination, label and program are declared here, and expected file contents come from the capture provenance, so nothing observed on disk becomes its own baseline. Paths start at the home directory (~) or the skills tree ({skills}).

targets.name: pchat
targets.proposed: a symlink to the staged environment's bin/pchat

targets.name: chat-bridge LaunchAgent
targets.label: com.coghex.chat-bridge
targets.proposed: ProgramArguments naming the staged environment's bin/chat-bridge

targets.name: rotate-logs LaunchAgent
targets.label: com.coghex.log-rotate
targets.proposed: ProgramArguments naming the staged environment's bin/rotate-logs

targets.name: WeeChat role_colors autoload link
targets.proposed: a symlink to role_colors.py in the staged environment's plateia_chat/scripts

targets.name: chat skill folder
targets.proposed: the release's chat skill: SKILL.md and skill.json from its skill archive

targets.name: Claude chat skill link
targets.proposed: unchanged: still a symlink to the chat skill folder

targets.name: chat/scripts import location
targets.proposed: a thin layer handing off to the selected release's plateia_chat modules (D-26)
